The logo: G4 with the three fixes

Holger, 27 Sep: G4 seems the closest, but the two lines should start in the same place in relation to their rotation, so that they both have the same distance to the card; they should not overlap, so there should be more distance between them; and the two lines should be centred on the line of the rotated big card. So: the two starts on one line that leans as the card’s right edge leans, each the same distance from it; the air between the lines doubled; and the block’s midpoint on the front card’s centre line carried on. Six rows on that, and G4 kept as it was for the comparison. The keepers stay as they are. Every row has a number and a name (say “H2”). Each row: the logo at 64px, then the site’s bar at a desktop width with the logo 32px tall, and a phone with it 24px tall.

H G4 with the three fixes

Holger: the two lines should start in the same place in relation to their rotation, so that both sit the same distance from the card; they should not overlap, so more distance between them; and the two lines should be centred on the line of the rotated big card. So: the two starts on one line that leans like the card’s right edge, so World of and Card Games each begin the same 16 from the edge; the air between the lines doubled; and the block’s midpoint set on the front card’s centre line carried on past its edge.

H1

The three fixes

G4 with the starts on the card’s lean, twice the air, and the block on the card’s centre line

World of and Card Games each begin 16 from the card’s right edge, on one line leaning as the edge leans. The gap between the lines is 0.30 of the capitals instead of 0.14. The midpoint between the two starts sits on the front card’s centre line, carried on past its edge, so the words hang where the card points.

On the bar: 109 px wide (today 170), the fan 26 px tall, the big line’s capitals 9 px tall, the small line’s 5 px. On a phone: 82 px wide. File: logo-lab-out/h1-fixes.svg
